title: Agent Loop Stoplight Gym
oneLiner: A playful trainer where teams set stop conditions for coding agents and watch loops succeed, stall, or burn budget.
targetUser: Developers, product teams, and operators learning to run autonomous coding agents without vague “keep going forever” instructions.
keyUx: Pick a mission, set evidence gates and stop conditions, run fake loop cards, and see whether the agent should continue, ask, stop, or escalate.
stitchPrompt: Create a playful training web app called “Agent Loop Stoplight Gym” for teams learning autonomous coding-agent operations. Include mission card picker, stop condition builder, evidence gate checklist, loop event deck, budget/time meter, continue/ask/stop controls, and a team runbook poster. Toy rule: choose stop conditions before the loop starts; score points only when you stop at the right evidence gate. Design direction: use the playful-experimental profile with bold stoplight states, training-game composition, readable scoring, tactile controls, and no generic dashboard framing.
